newsitem.title: USA: NYCE cotton called to open flat to up 0.20 cent.
newsitem.headline: NYCE cotton called to open flat to up 0.20 cent.

text.p: NYCE cotton futures were called to open unchanged to 0.20 cent per lb firmer on Wednesday, based on market orders at 1018 EDT, traders said.
They expect prices to trade narrowly ahead of Thursday's weekly export and sales report.
Thursday is also the first notice day for May cotton. Open interest in the spot month stood at 12,009 lots as of Monday's close.
Tuesday, most-active July finished 0.41 cent per lb firmer at 72.90 cents, having ranged from 73.00 to 72.49 cents per lb. Spot May closed 0.28 cent higher at 71.08 cents.
Support basis July was pegged at 72.00 cents, below its life-of-contract low of 72.05 cents.
